definition: everything you can see from one place
description: The top of an old stone tower at sunset. A smiling young man in a white linen shirt leans on the lichen-covered wall, looks out, points at the view and laughs, and a second person's arms rest on the wall in the foreground. Below them spreads a wide view: red-tiled rooftops, a green river crossed by old stone arched bridges, rows of vineyards and olive trees, tall cypresses, and blue hills under pink and golden clouds.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er bewundert die Aussicht vom Turm.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Está admirando las vistas desde la torre.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il admire la vue depuis la tour.
fr.question: Que fait le jeune homme ?
